question: What vital and beneficent roles does the goddess hold toward Rāvaṇa?
premises: The goddess is described as the life of the lord of the ten-necked one.
The goddess grants boons to the ten-necked one.
Both epithets attribute sustaining and beneficent power to her.
inference: The goddess is a vital sustaining presence and a giver of boons in relation to Rāvaṇa.
uncertainties: The referent of īśvara in daśagrīva+īśvara is ambiguous in this verse.
plain_english: She is the life of the lord of the ten-necked Rāvaṇa and the giver of boons to him.
